scenarios.name: The straight shot
scenarios.desc: 2.5 m powered vehicle, hot motor, no reply to ID pings, at night. Enters through Angels Gate and heads for the Fuel Pier.

expect.why: Unknown powered vehicle entering at night: ask
Clearly aiming at fuel: prepare to hold
Under 10 min from fuel: hand off

scenarios.name: The fake-out
scenarios.desc: 1.5 m powered vehicle, no reply, at night. Enters through Queens Gate, fakes toward the Oil Islands, then turns for the Cruise Terminal (ship docked).

expect.why: Small vehicle heading for oil islands: give way
Heading for a docked cruise ship: give way
Last 10 min to a ship full of people: hold

scenarios.name: The lost glider
scenarios.desc: Registered research glider that stopped reporting. Cold, drifting slowly with the current near the Research Dock.

expect.why: Lost, not hostile: log, tell the lab

scenarios.name: The tiny drone
scenarios.desc: 0.4 m micro vehicle, hot motor, no reply, daytime. Comes in through Angels Gate and heads for the Research Dock.

expect.why: Tiny payload, low-value target: ask and watch, never move boats

scenarios.name: Late detection
scenarios.desc: 5 m powered vehicle at 3.5 m/s, no reply, at night. First seen just inside Angels Gate, a few minutes from the container ship at Pier 400.

expect.why: Big, fast, close to a ship: high right away
